- Initial release of the self-improvement skill for OpenClaw and generic coding agents.

- Removed obsolete OpenClaw hook handler file (hooks/openclaw/handler.ts).
- Provides markdown-based logging for learnings, errors, and feature requests.
- Includes detailed setup instructions for both OpenClaw-based workflows and generic agent environments.
